name: 部署模型选择器 / 长名称和版本 / 选中内容保持单行且位于原控件高度内
scope: Only the deployment model selector height contract; not all Select widgets or the deployment workflow
fixture: One uniquely named run-owned model registered through the real browser_metadata API with explicit metadata; independent GET checks its identity. No remote model files, agent, or browser management mocks. Existing cleanup discovers only the run-owned repository and verifies DELETE/404 and an empty query.

fields.request: Page GET /models?page=1&page_size=50; GET /models/{id} on deep link
fields.persistence: Fixture metadata persisted by real POST then independently read. The draft is not submitted.
covered: empty control height captured before selection at each viewport
long name and full revision present in the actual dropdown
mouse selection and URL refill preserve readable model identity
selected control height equals empty control height within CSS subpixel tolerance
selected label and every text line stay inside the control vertically

component_checklist.assertion: One registered option: exact name and full revision before/after selection, no-files detail, empty placeholder, height and text bounds. Disabled candidates are not constructed.
Mouse selection and URL refill read the exact fixture ID through real API; no deployment is saved.
Search variations belong to the existing RTL suite; not exercised in this geometry case.
ModelPicker does not expose allowClear; each viewport starts with a fresh empty deployment draft.
Dependent engine/template fields are outside this selector-height contract.
Keyboard focus and ArrowDown open the associated popup; mouse selection closes it. Arrow-key candidate changes are not asserted.
Asynchronous failure and deleted model scenarios are not exercised here.

other_reachable_controls.reason: Vendor/template/name/served name, node, resource, image, engine and submit flows remain outside this targeted layout case; no deployment submission.

runtime.reason: Select rendering does not execute a workload; no GPU/inference claim.

mutations.behavior: Restore the pre-fix model label for the selected value
mutations.expected_failure: selected label escapes the single-line control

missing: All other dropdown consumers, menus and multi-select controls
Automatic CI execution of this browser case; the checked-in Make target must be invoked explicitly
result: NOT_RUN until an actual matching report passes required evidence and observed cleanup
